description:
Moves the label, bulk-update and batch-create methods onto the existing issues facade, completing the issue family's narrowing.

## Background

`CommandExecutor` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs`) carries every command family in one public surface of about 195 methods across 28 `impl` blocks, so a consumer of one family accepts all of them. This family lives in `commands/labels.rs`, `commands/bulk_update.rs` and `commands/batch_create.rs`: `get_issue`, `list_label_values`, `apply_bulk_update`, `preview_bulk_update`, `validate_batch_from_json` and `batch_create_from_json`. Callers: the label, `issue update --filter` and `issue batch-create` arms of `crates/jit/src/main.rs` (or their handler modules) and their test suites.

The facade shape: `CommandExecutor::<family>()` returns a borrowing struct holding `&CommandExecutor<S>`; the family's methods live in `impl` blocks on that struct in the family's own `commands/` file, and each block keeps the storage bound its `impl CommandExecutor` block had (`IssueStore`, `IssueStore + RepositoryStateStore`, or concrete `JsonFileStorage`). The kernel (sessions, rule and config caches, `require_active_lease`, the validation `capture_*` helpers) stays on `CommandExecutor`; a facade method reaches it through its executor reference, and calls into another family go through that family's accessor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every public method listed in the Background is a method of the existing `IssueOps<'_, S>` reached through `CommandExecutor::issues()`, rather than of `CommandExecutor`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each `IssueOps` impl block for these methods carries the storage bound of the `CommandExecutor` block it replaces, so no method becomes callable on a storage it could not use before.
- [hard] REQ-03: Callers in `crates/jit`, `crates/server` and their test suites reach the moved methods through `issues()`, intra-doc links name the new paths, and the workspace builds, lints and passes its existing suites with no assertion changed.

## Notes

- Behaviour, output and exit codes are unchanged; the compile and the existing suites are the test boundary.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Label and batch issue methods onto the issues facade
